svg.title: SRFM Lab: price paths as worldlines
svg.desc: SPY daily closes 2025-08-20 to 2025-10-24 drawn as a spacetime worldline with a light cone at every bar, computed by lib/srfm_core.py.
svg.text: Price paths drawn as worldlines. Every bar is tested against
a light cone; runs of ordered bars build mass until a well forms.
SPY daily closes, 2025-08-20 to 2025-10-24. c = 0.5% per day, bh_form = 1.5.
